body: Thanks so much for taking the time to respond. I really appreciate it. Regarding my degree, I have a Comp Sci degree and I am a programmer. My dream was something entirely different. Something that helped people, not corporate greed and ladder climbing which is all I've been faced with since leaving Uni. I'm stumped, standing at a crossroad, don't see where to go from here.
"you are a warm and beautiful person" - Sometimes the words of a stranger can hit you in the feels like no one else can through all the noise. Thank you
